name: Relying On God
overview: Scripture reveals that relying on God is foundational for the believer's strength and security, as He is described as a rock, fortress, and deliverer in whom we can fully trust (Psalms 18:2). Trusting the Lord with all our heart means rejecting reliance on our own understanding and instead embracing His unsearchable wisdom and everlasting power (Proverbs 3:5; Isaiah 40:28). Even amid affliction, God faithfully delivers and sustains His people, holding their hands and assuring them of His help and peace-filled plans for their future (Psalms 34:19; Isaiah 41:13; Jeremiah 29:11).
